name: homeshed-mcp
description: Every tool your AI needs, in one install: memory, reasoning, git, network and more. Tools that act on your machines start off.
long_description: A self-hosted MCP tool server: built-in memory, reasoning, git, files, network and code checks work with nothing else installed; other tools connect to what you already run, such as a local model, Docker or ntfy. Tools that act on your machines start switched off.

local_ai_base_url.title: Local model address (optional)
local_ai_base_url.description: An OpenAI-compatible server you run, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama. Leave empty if you don't run one.

enable_tools.title: Write tools to switch on (optional)
enable_tools.description: Comma-separated, e.g. git.commit,git.push. Leave empty to keep every tool that changes things off.
